name: Returns
headline: Apparel returns 1.6× category benchmark — 'runs small' cluster

data.tradeoff: 6 prevention fixes plus the disposition rules save +$21.4K a quarter — +$16.6K by preventing returns and +$4.8K by routing the ones that still happen. The fit cohort is projected to fall from 18.4% to 9.4%, read on a lag rather than immediately.
